csv_scope_of_work: Florida State College at Jacksonville requests qualification statements from firms interested in providing Professional Engineering consultant continuing contracting services on an as needed basis to include but not limited to the responsibility of coordinate planning, engineering design and construction activities which maximize the use of available funds for each project/jobRFQ 2027C-01 Engineering Consultant Continuing Contracting Services (Defined Engineering Disciplines) RFQ Solicitation and Submission documents can be obtained and submitted at the following links: Civil Engineering Electrical, Mechanical & Energy/Commissioning Engineering Environmental & Bldg. Envelope Moisture Engineering Fire Protection Engineering GeoTechnical & Material Testing Engineering Structural Engineering This solicitation does not include architectural, surveying or mapping services. The college intends to evaluate submissions and award new continuing contract(s) as deemed in the best interest of the College. Firm(s) and joint venture(s) licensed to practice engineering should apply. Participation by minority/women owned and controlled business is encouraged.

title: FSCJ Professional Engineering Continuing Contract
short_description: Continuing engineering consulting contract for Florida State College at Jacksonville projects.
project_scope: As-needed continuing professional engineering consulting services for Florida State College at Jacksonville projects, including coordination of planning, engineering design, and construction activities to maximize available funds for each project. The solicitation covers multiple engineering disciplines, including structural engineering, civil engineering, electrical, mechanical and energy/commissioning, environmental and building envelope moisture, fire protection, and geotechnical/material testing. No specific building, bridge, span, floor area, or construction volume is defined.
services: Continuing engineering consultant services on an as-needed basis; coordination of planning, engineering design, and construction activities; discipline-specific engineering services including structural engineering. Architectural, surveying, and mapping services are explicitly excluded from this solicitation.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a continuing contract/framework-style procurement without a defined project or structure.
- It includes structural engineering, which is generally relevant to sbp.
- However, no specific complex structure, bridge, long-span roof, or architecturally demanding building is identified.
- The tender is broad and multi-disciplinary, focused on general on-call consulting for a college.
- Framework agreements without technical specification are explicitly of low interest according to the guidance.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is for an as-needed continuing engineering services contract covering future unspecified projects, so no realistic project-specific construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee, budget, upset limit, or contract value is stated in the provided notice. As this is a continuing services contract for unspecified future tasks, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be made from the available information.
references_qualifications: Firms and joint ventures licensed to practice engineering should apply. Qualification statements are requested from firms interested in providing continuing professional engineering consultant services. Structural engineering is one of the defined engineering disciplines. Minority/women-owned and controlled business participation is encouraged.
award_criteria: The college intends to evaluate submissions and award new continuing contract(s) as deemed in the best interest of the College. No detailed weighted award criteria are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Florida State College at Jacksonville, Jacksonville, Florida, USA. Email: purchasing@fscj.edu. Phone: 904-632-3084. Fax: 904-632-3087. Website: https://www.fscj.edu/discover/governance-administration/purchasing/bids-schedule
notes: Project name: FSCJ Professional Engineering Continuing Contract. Project number/RFQ: 2027C-01. Target market: Universities/Colleges. County: Duval. State: Florida. Pre-submittal meeting via WebEx on 2026-06-10 at 10:00 AM EDT; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-06-23 05:00 PM EDT. Although the source lists several disciplines requested including architecture services, surveying/GIS/mapping, and construction/project management, the scope text also states that this solicitation does not include architectural, surveying, or mapping services; this appears inconsistent and should be verified in the full RFQ documents.
